result.statement: ALTER TABLE users ALTER COLUMN full_name SET NOT NULL
result.rationale: SET NOT NULL performs a full table scan while holding ACCESS EXCLUSIVE. Safe pattern: add a NOT VALID CHECK constraint, VALIDATE it, then SET NOT NULL.
